summary: Closing note that testing is organization- and site-specific but everyone benefits from it, with see-also links.
questions: How much testing should I add to my Ansible deployments?

answer_card.title: How much to test
answer_card.answer_md: Testing is organization- and site-specific: what makes sense depends on what you deploy and who uses it. Everyone should do some, because it makes deployments more robust and reliable.
